MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

3. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

4. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

5. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

6. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

7. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

8. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

12. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media ownership and management P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Media ownership and management Page 12 of 42 1 STRAND 1.0: MEDIA CONTENT CREATIO and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
